decision.reasoning_trace: Out of the backpacks presented, prod_backpacks_057 stands out as the highest-value option. It has a significantly higher volume of reviews (over 6,000) with a strong 4.7-star rating. Users specifically mention its durability, modularity (Molle system), and storage capacity (45L), making it suitable for both travel and hiking. While prod_backpacks_164 is similar, it has fewer reviews. prod_backpacks_194 is interesting as a cooler backpack, but prod_backpacks_057 serves as a more versatile general-purpose rucksack for the price.
